answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake: every agent must lock collateral before it can act, so spawning a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds, not one. Like a willow that bends without snapping, honest agents recover their deposit, while cheaters are slashed. Reputation earned slowly toward its zenith becomes a scarce pigment that cannot be counterfeited cheaply, so forging many identities only dilutes the paint until the fraud stops paying.
